description:
Harbor is an open source trusted cloud native registry project that stores, signs, and scans container images. Harbor extends the open source Docker Distribution by adding features like security, identity and management. This package includes Harbor core, portal, jobservice, registry, PostgreSQL, and Valkey (Redis-compatible cache). Supports image replication, vulnerability scanning (via Trivy, optional), and role-based access control.

Default credentials: admin / Harbor12345

tips.before_install:
Harbor is a large application that requires at least 4 GB of RAM and 2 CPU cores. Initial startup may take 2-3 minutes while PostgreSQL initializes and all services become healthy.

Default admin credentials: admin / Harbor12345
Change the admin password from the Web UI after installation.

The registry is accessible on port 18080. To push/pull images, configure your Docker daemon with the registry address.

author: IceWhaleTech

releaseNotes.en_US:
- Harbor v2.15.1 stable release.
- Includes core, portal, jobservice, registry, PostgreSQL, and Valkey (Redis-compatible cache).
- No Trivy scanner included by default; add it later if vulnerability scanning is needed.
- Default admin: admin / Harbor12345. Change after first login.
